bio_am: Ծնած է Հին Նախիջեւան՝ 1875-ին։ Քսան տարի կռուեցաւ Կովկասի, Պարսկաստանի եւ Երկրի մէջ, ու ինկաւ 1915-ին՝ դէպի Մուշ տանող ճանապարհին։
bio_en: Khachatur Amirian, known as Dashnaktsakan Khecho, was born in 1875 into a well-to-do family in Old Nakhichevan. Imprisoned in Ekaterinodar, he escaped with great difficulty to Persia in 1902, and he organised self-defence during the 1903 church-property crisis and the Armenian-Tatar clashes, receiving a facial wound in the Karabakh fighting. For nearly twenty years he fought in the Caucasus, Persia and Ottoman Armenia, including in Persia with Rostom and Yeprem. In 1915 he fell leading an attack to clear the road to Mush; Kosti Hambardzumian spoke at his burial on 11 July 1915, and his obituary appeared in Ashkhatank (Van) the same day.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Exact place of death not stated (attack on the road toward Mush, 1915); #413 'Khecho's death' and #24 (burial speech) relate.
